headline: As of 2026-10-09: 2,439,315 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 33 of 50 states, D+27.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 2,439,315 early/mail ballots cast so far across 33 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+27.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (479,785), Florida (433,422), Michigan (297,071).
